title: A column predicate on the fact table leaves the row's own filter in place
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), "Amount", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], Sales[Quantity] > 1 ) )

source.quote: it will not spread its effects to the whole Product table, as a filter on Sales did
source.supports: the article's corrected query: the column filter does not touch Product, so each color keeps its own value

derivation: Rows with Quantity > 1: 2, 4, 5, 6. Red (products 1, 2): rows 2 and 5 = 40 + 200 = 240. Blue (product 3): rows 4 and 6 = 50 + 30 = 80. Green (product 4) has no sales: BLANK.
